name: Camping Guggemos
beschreibung: Camping Guggemos is situated in Füssen (recorded under Tyrol) on the scenic shores of Lake Forggensee. The campsite offers parcelled pitches for motorhomes and caravans with electric hookups. The sanitary building is equipped with showers, washbasins, and chemical toilet disposal facilities. A kiosk provides guests with fresh baked goods and refreshing beverages. Hiking trails into the surrounding Alps and cycling paths along the lake start directly from the campsite.
